title: How Biogen is returning to its roots with a West Coast immunology outpost
summary: On its face, there wasn’t much notable about Biogen’s May 2024 acquisition of Human Immunology Biosciences (HI-Bio). A $1.15 billion upfront payment to secure a phase 3-ready monoclonal antibody is chump change in the broader world of biopharma M&A, the kind of deal companies strike every day in this industry.
